name: traverse
author: Polk County GIS Department — Eric McAvoy and Nicholas Cramer
label: Traverse Tool
description: COGO traverse tool for entering survey courses by bearing and distance. Supports quadrant (N 45°30'00" E) and azimuth formats, straight and curve courses, per-course feet/chains/meters/rods units, snapping to map features, traverse rotation, a two-point inverse readout, map visualization with leg labels, a closure report with precision ratio and enclosed area, and GeoJSON / Esri traverse file (.txt) export and import. No external dependencies.
